findings.heading: Who decides this, and what you do not file
findings.observed: The long guide says the clerk certifies first and narrates the Side Two clerk certificate before the judge's order. Current official AOC-CR-287 instructions paragraph 5 instead place copying, clerk certification and distribution after entry of an expunction order. Side Two itself certifies a copy of the entered order. The correct official instructions remain page 3 of every reviewed PDF; the contradiction is in the long Markdown guide, not those PDF pages.
findings.correction: State: participant completes/signs/files petition; court decides and enters the order; if granted, clerk certifies copies and distributes them. Preserve all court/clerk execution blanks and do not invent ordinary participant service on the prosecutor. This is an instruction correction answered by the official source, not a new counsel question.

ROUTE_IDENTITY.finding: Reviewed ordinary participant dismissal relief under 15A-146(a)/(a1), AOC-CR-287, in the county where charged. Acquittal, DA-filed alternatives and DNA subsection (b1) are not substituted. The composed DNA family is distinct.

District/Superior, all/some dismissals, civil revocation, no-deferred certification, financial basis and execution selections remain for truthful participant completion. PROTECTED_FIELDS.finding: Every petition Side Two, G106 court/provider/oath execution block and CV226 execution block was visually examined. No fabricated signature/date, financial amount, notary act, provider certification, judicial finding or grant. G106 purpose alone is checked. ARTIFACTS.finding: All ten current whole-PDF hashes and all sixty PNG hashes were measured. Full family tree and central verdict Git blob match connected GitHub. Nevertheless the generated binding omits the admitted receipt and selects the diagnostic unconditionally: CHAT4-NC-01.

PAGE_ORDER.finding: Every PDF: CR287 pages1-2; official instructions page3; optional G106 pages4-5; optional CV226 pages6-7 only with supplement; completion guide last. All sixty page positions individually inspected, including complete reverse sides.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.finding: All sixty full page instances individually displayed and inspected, including long boundary name/address/case/phone. No observed clipping, overlap, invisible fill, missing glyph or truncated value. Existing central geometric results remain separately attributed to that run; the builder's glyph-rectangle detector was not rerun.

FILING_DESTINATION.finding: Clerk of superior court in county where charged, with criminal-case division confirmed. Current source requires agency addresses and retention of permanent record/order copies; instructions disclose them. No county-specific clerk response was invented.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: 15A-146(d) and current court instructions support ordinary no-fee dismissal, the $175 deferred/conditional fee and indigent exception. G106 is actually present when selected; CV226 only accompanies a specifically requested financial supplement. Current owner-relayed batch04 directions are preserved. No missing-operative-G106 hold is repeated for these completed outputs.

SERVICE.finding: Ordinary participant DA service is not invented; separate DNA notice remains separate. Long guide wrongly places clerk certification before the court's order, contrary to official instructions paragraph5: CHAT4-NC-02.

SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: Retained individualized deferred/conditional, incapacity, felony-plea, uncertain disposition, sequencing, DNA and immigration stops remain. Fee/sponsorship selection does not eliminate them. No generic AI/counsel limitation is added and no unprovided counsel approval is claimed.
